problem: Hotels run many manual front and back of house tasks across PMS, POS and RMS systems.
business_model: B2B software and agents for hotels (pricing not public)
product_category: Autonomous AI agents for hotel operations

founders.name: Saman Sayahpour
education: Carnegie Mellon, dropped out of BS Logic and Computation (YC page)

competitors.name: Operto
competitors.what: Guest services agent and Operto ONE for independent hotels

technical_complexity.rationale: Computer use agents over legacy systems with supervision are demanding but feasible.

defensibility.rationale: Memory layer of SOPs and guest histories helps but the approach is replicable.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: PMS vendors shipping agent features; outcome unknown.

market_need_then: Hotel operators were adopting agentic AI in 2025, with Mews publishing a report in Nov 2025.

brand_strength.rationale: No public brand coverage was found.

outcome_analysis: Axelrod is a two person Summer 2026 company with no outcome yet. It claims use at Michelin Key hotels across continents, which is unverified. Competition is already active in hotel agents and traction is the key risk.
notes: Funding unverified: Dealroom lists a $125k seed without investors. Founder roles are 'Founder' on the YC page. Primary partner Brad Flora. Customer claims differ (Marriott, 3 vs 4 continents). Completeness pass: Round rests on a single database (Dealroom), no date or investors.
